proof_summary: Introduce cumulative tail masses, which obey the averaging recurrence \(Q(t+1,k+1)=\lfloor(Q(t,k)+Q(t,k+1))/2\rfloor\), and use positivity, mass conservation, and spatial monotonicity to characterize stabilization by \(Q(t,n-1)>0\). At the minimal stabilization time for mass \(n\), diagonal propagation estimates show mass \(n+1\) stabilizes within two more steps, while a reverse positivity shift would make mass \(n\) stabilize earlier if mass \(n+1\) stabilized no later, so its stabilization time is exactly one or two steps greater.
